checklist.prompt: What is the exact read-only root path for the TIFF/ResCarta archive?
checklist.why_it_matters: All inventory and intake tools need a stable root path. We should not guess or crawl unrelated shares.

checklist.prompt: Which machine is approved to run read-only inventory and pilot scripts?
checklist.why_it_matters: The processing host determines path syntax, available disk, network speed, and whether OCR tools can be installed.

checklist.prompt: Where are we allowed to write derived outputs such as OCR text, manifests, logs, and indexes?
checklist.why_it_matters: The source archive should stay read-only; derived data needs a separate approved location.

checklist.prompt: Are there export, retention, or access-control rules for technical manuals and derived OCR text?
checklist.why_it_matters: OCR text, vectors, and summaries are derived from controlled source material and may need the same access restrictions.

checklist.prompt: What is the folder layout: one document per folder, ResCarta object folders, pages/ocr subfolders, ZIPs, or mixed?
checklist.why_it_matters: The scanner must group pages into documents without relying only on filenames.

checklist.prompt: Where are metadata files such as metadata.xml, JSON, MARC, or ResCarta descriptors stored?
checklist.why_it_matters: Metadata gives document IDs, titles, page order, and source-link information.

checklist.prompt: Are TIFF filenames globally unique, document-local, or only page-number based?
checklist.why_it_matters: Our sample has duplicate stems across pages/OCR folders; production matching should use full path plus metadata.

checklist.prompt: Does the server contain full-page OCR, header-only OCR, or no OCR? Where is it stored?
checklist.why_it_matters: OpenSearch, Qdrant, graph extraction, and RAG require body OCR, not just headers.

checklist.prompt: If OCR exists, what format is it in: plain text, ALTO XML, hOCR, PDF text layer, database field, or ResCarta export?
checklist.why_it_matters: Different formats need different importers and quality checks.

checklist.prompt: Do we have OCR confidence data or sample pages to compare against the TIFF images?
checklist.why_it_matters: OCR quality determines whether part extraction and RAG are reliable.

checklist.prompt: What is the real ResCarta deep-link URL format for a document/page?
checklist.why_it_matters: The local MVP uses placeholder links. Production needs links users can open.

checklist.prompt: Does ResCarta require authentication, VPN, cookies, or role-based access?
checklist.why_it_matters: The UI must show source links only to users with the right access.

checklist.prompt: Roughly how many TIFF files and total bytes are in scope?
checklist.why_it_matters: The cost depends on page count, not only terabytes.

checklist.prompt: Is there a change feed, modified-time policy, or manifest that identifies new/changed pages?
checklist.why_it_matters: After baseline, incremental processing should avoid rescanning the full archive.

checklist.prompt: Can we copy or process a small pilot set, for example 500 to 5,000 pages, before baseline?
checklist.why_it_matters: A pilot proves OCR/extraction/index quality before large-scale processing.

checklist.prompt: Where will PostgreSQL live, and who manages backups, access, and schema migrations?
checklist.why_it_matters: PostgreSQL will hold graph/catalog/source/feedback records.

checklist.prompt: Where will OpenSearch live, and what index/retention limits should we assume?
checklist.why_it_matters: OpenSearch will hold searchable OCR/page/chunk text, which can be large.

checklist.prompt: Where will Qdrant live, and what vector dimension/model/collection policy should we use?
checklist.why_it_matters: Qdrant stores embeddings and page/chunk pointers, not TIFF bytes.

checklist.prompt: What user/group permissions should be carried from source files into search results and graph records?
checklist.why_it_matters: Search and RAG must not reveal sources users cannot access.

checklist.prompt: Do we need an audit log for source opens, questions, answers, feedback, and exports?
checklist.why_it_matters: Technical data systems often need traceable usage history.

decision_points: If OCR is full-page and usable, import/clean it before OCR generation.
If OCR is missing or header-only, run a controlled full-page OCR pilot.
If TIFF count is extremely high, use selective/on-demand AI page context instead of all-page context.
If ResCarta deep links are unknown, keep local source review links but mark real ResCarta not ready.
guardrails: Do not run OCR, embeddings, or page-context generation across the full server on first access.
Start with read-only inventory and OCR-depth audit using --max-files.
Treat source TIFF locations as read-only; write derived outputs elsewhere.
Do not store TIFF bytes in PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, or Qdrant.
Require explicit approval before any large baseline processing run.
Use pilot batches and quality gates before scaling.
purpose: Prepare for read-only real-server inventory, OCR-depth audit, pilot OCR, and safe batched intake.

runbook_steps.command: dir <SERVER_ROOT>  # Windows, or ls <SERVER_ROOT> on Git Bash/Linux
runbook_steps.expected_output: You can list the top-level source folders without permission errors.
runbook_steps.goal: Verify the approved root path and confirm scripts will only read from it.
runbook_steps.name: Confirm read-only access
runbook_steps.stop_if: Access denied, path unknown, or path points to a broader share than intended.

runbook_steps.expected_output: A JSON inventory report with TIFF count, bytes, OCR count, and rough scale estimates.
runbook_steps.goal: Count files, measure sizes, and estimate scale without OCR/indexing.
runbook_steps.name: Read-only inventory sample
runbook_steps.stop_if: The scan sees unrelated files, too many permission errors, or unexpected file layout.

runbook_steps.expected_output: An OCR-depth report showing missing/header-only/full-page OCR counts.
runbook_steps.goal: Determine whether OCR is missing, header-only, empty, or full-page.
runbook_steps.name: OCR-depth sample
runbook_steps.stop_if: Most OCR is missing/header-only and no OCR-generation path is approved yet.

runbook_steps.expected_output: A batch audit report that confirms document organization and risky files.
runbook_steps.goal: Check folder shape, duplicate names, empty files, TIFF/OCR pairing, and metadata presence.
runbook_steps.name: Document batch shape audit
runbook_steps.stop_if: Duplicate matching is ambiguous, metadata is missing, or empty TIFF/metadata files appear.

runbook_steps.expected_output: Pilot OCR files and an OCR pilot report under local_data/ocr/pilot/.
runbook_steps.goal: Run OCR on a small pilot set to validate OCR quality before baseline processing.
runbook_steps.name: Small OCR pilot only after approval
runbook_steps.stop_if: No OCR engine is approved/available, or pilot OCR is not good enough for extraction.

runbook_steps.expected_output: Quality gate is OK for the pilot/local sample.
runbook_steps.goal: Run source/OCR/graph/query quality checks against the pilot before scaling.
runbook_steps.name: Pilot quality gate
runbook_steps.stop_if: Any source, OCR, graph, API, or user-query check fails.
